function.description: Get the markdown content of a documentation page by its route. Use when: When you know which page the user needs and want to read its full content. Do not use when: When you need to search for pages first (use search_docs instead).
function.name: get_page_content

function.description: List all available API methods (actions) with their names and descriptions. Use when: When you need to discover what tools are available before calling them. Do not use when: When you already know which action to call.
function.name: list_api_methods

function.description: Search documentation pages by keyword. Returns matching pages with title, summary, and route. Use when: When the user asks about a topic and you need to find relevant documentation pages. Do not use when: When the user asks for the full content of a specific page (use get_page_content instead).
function.name: search_docs
